pages.title: Standard Turrets
pages.text: Standard turrets are turrets that cannot switch to manual head-aim mode.$(br2)Thanks to the advanced blade system, they require no operator and support fully automatic targeting. Valid targets include several entity types and hostile subspaces.$(br2)Their GUI lets you choose target types, default Pitch/Yaw angles for a tidy resting orientation, and permitted targeting Pitch/Yaw ranges so a turret mounted against a wall does not shoot its own vessel.$(br2)All turrets use X for horizontal rotation and Y for vertical elevation.
